title: The Man Who Survived Two Atomic Bombs: Tsutomu Yamaguchi #shorts
description:
Did you know this story? 👇

The true story of Tsutomu Yamaguchi, the man who survived both atomic bombs, Hiroshima and Nagasaki, in August 1945.
Around 160 people are believed to have lived through both blasts, but Japan officially recognized only one of them, and not until 2009.

title: What If You Landed on Every Planet Without a Spacesuit?
description:
Would you go to Titan just to fly? 👇

What would happen if you landed on every planet without a spacesuit? We rank the Sun, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, the Moon, Mars and Titan from deadliest to most survivable.
Including the true story of NASA technician Jim LeBlanc, who was exposed to near vacuum in 1965 and survived.

title: What If You Fell Into the Grand Canyon? Movies vs Reality #shorts
description:
Would you ever hike the inner canyon? 👇

What happens if you fall into the Grand Canyon? Movies vs reality: fall time, heat and rescue cost.
The canyon is a staircase of ledges, so most falls are far shorter than a mile.

title: What If You Dug Straight Down? Where You'd Really Come Out #shorts
description:
Did you think it was China? 👇

What happens if you dig a hole through the Earth from the US? The deepest hole ever dug, the Kola Superdeep Borehole, and where you'd really come out.
The Kola hole reached about 7.6 miles, only 0.2% of the way to the Earth's center.

title: What Happens If You Stop Sleeping? The 11-Day Record #shorts
description:
How long can you go without sleep? 👇

What happens to your body if you stop sleeping? The true story of Randy Gardner, who stayed awake 264 hours in 1964.
Guinness stopped tracking sleep-deprivation records because they were too dangerous.

title: The Girl Who Survived a 2-Mile Fall: Juliane Koepcke's True Story
description:
Would you have followed the water? 👇

Juliane Koepcke survived a two-mile fall from an exploding plane and walked out of the Amazon alone. This is the true story of LANSA Flight 508.
She was the only survivor of 92 people, and her story has a twist involving filmmaker Werner Herzog and a jungle research station.
